readme.html:
Editmamei

Give your AI assistant a real photo editor.

An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI apps edit your photos in desktop Photoshop or GIMP. It edits the photo you have instead of generating a new one, and leaves you a layered file you can keep working on.

Install · Website · Docs · Editmamei Connect · Report a bug


A real run: 73 travel photos, one sentence, graded in Photoshop.

Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Adobe Inc.

What you can ask

Talk to your assistant the way you'd brief a retoucher. These are three real requests, each in a fresh chat, with the result each one got.

"Replace the sky with one of Photoshop's sunset skies. Keep the waterfall, the cliffs and the spray exactly as they are, warm the foreground a little so the light matches the new sky, then check the horizon at full size for halos or leftover patches of the old sky and fix them before you call it done."

About 8 minutes
"Give this beach photo a bright, airy summer-afternoon look. Lift the shadows on the sand so it reads clean and white, deepen the blue in the sky while keeping the clouds bright, and let the umbrella's colors pop without looking fake."

About 6 minutes
"Get this ready for three places: an Instagram post, an Instagram story with room at the top and bottom for text, and an 8x10 print for a frame. Keep the puppy's face and both ears in frame in all three."

About 4 minutes

Smaller requests work too, like "Isolate the subject onto its own layer with a clean mask" or "Export a 2048px web JPEG."

Here's the waterfall edit in its session. Your AI app runs beside your editor, and the result arrives on layers you can open and change yourself.

Install

Claude Desktop, no terminal

  1. Download editmamei.mcpb.
  2. In Claude Desktop, go to Settings → Desktop app → Manage (next to Extensions) → Advanced settings → Install Extension… and choose the downloaded file.
  3. Restart Claude Desktop, then ask it: "Is Photoshop connected?"

This route doesn't need Node.js, because Claude Desktop ships its own runtime. The install guide covers older versions of the app and updates.

Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP apps

npm install -g editmamei
editmamei install   # registers with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code
editmamei status    # shows which AI apps it's registered with

Then restart your AI app and ask it: "Is Photoshop connected?" For anything editmamei install doesn't detect, see docs/clients.md.

Requirements
Editor Adobe Photoshop 2026 (v27.x) on Windows 10/11 or macOS 13+, or GIMP 3.2 on Windows, macOS, or Linux
AI app Any app that can run a local MCP server
Node.js 22+, for the npm route only

What to expect

A first edit takes a while. The three requests above took 4 to 8 minutes, because your AI looks, plans, and checks at every step. Editmamei ships no chat model of its own, so every edit spends your AI app's tokens, and we measured what an edit costs.

Editmamei Connect

Want to edit from a browser or your phone, or don't have Photoshop or GIMP on this computer? Editmamei Connect is the hosted version. Add it to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI app as a connector, send a photo, and get it back edited. There's nothing to install, and it's free to start.

Connect is a separate product, and its source isn't in this repository. It edits on Editmamei's server instead of on your computer, so your photo is uploaded, and uploads are deleted after 24 hours.

How it works

Your AI app decides each step and calls Editmamei's tools. Editmamei carries the step out in your editor and reports back with structured results and, when your AI needs to look, a preview. Your AI reads those and decides what to do next. Editmamei also sends content-free usage telemetry and checks npm for updates; see Privacy.

  • Real edits. Photoshop or GIMP does the pixel work with its own engine, and no generative model changes your pixels.
  • Reversible. In Photoshop, adjustments land as adjustment layers and destructive pixel operations run on an automatic duplicate. In GIMP, adjustments stay live filters, and checkpoints stand in for undo.
  • Checked, not assumed. Histograms, region comparisons, and selection previews let your AI measure its own work.
  • On-device vision. In Photoshop, face, object, and scene detection run locally on bundled ONNX models, so your AI can target "the person on the left" without a cloud vision call.
  • Only verified tools ship. A new tool stays out of the tool list until it has passed live sessions against real Photoshop or GIMP.

112 tools: 83 for Photoshop (62 Community, 21 Pro) and 29 for GIMP (all Community). The full list is in docs/tools.md.

GIMP

When GIMP 3.2 is detected on your machine, a gimp_* tool set registers next to the ps_* one, for when you ask for GIMP or Photoshop isn't available. Edits happen in a background gimp-console process with no visible window, and you follow along through previews in the conversation. GIMP doesn't yet cover heal/clone or AI subject and sky selection. Details and troubleshooting, including Linux, are in docs/gimp.md.

Free and Pro

Pro is a Photoshop-only upgrade and adds nothing to the GIMP tools. The split is detailed in pro-features.md, and pricing is at editmamei.com/desktop/pricing.

This repository holds the Community source. Pro is a separately licensed module and its source is not published here. Community never imports it, so this tree builds and runs on its own.

Privacy

Editmamei runs on your computer and edits in your desktop editor. No image content or file paths are sent to Editmamei's servers.

What Where it goes Setting
Your photo file Stays on your computer, apart from the previews below and any Adobe cloud selection
Previews, 1024px on the long edge by default (your AI can ask for up to 8192px) Your AI app's model provider, the same as dropping a photo into a chat privacy.send_previews_to_llm (on)
Tool results, such as file paths, layer names, measurements, and metadata like GPS if your AI asks for it Your AI app's model provider
Content-free usage telemetry, with a random install ID Editmamei telemetry.usage (on)
Sanitized error details Editmamei, only if you opt in telemetry.diagnostics (off)
Update check, with no identifiers The npm registry update_check (on)

Change these with editmamei config set <setting> false (or true). The Claude Desktop extension has its own switches for telemetry, diagnostics, and the update check. Pro also sends your license key and a per-device activation ID to a third-party licensing service, and to Editmamei's delivery service to check for module updates, plus a hashed device ID at activation. These have no setting. Photoshop's own Select Subject and Select Sky can use Adobe's cloud, depending on Photoshop's Image Processing preference.

Every field is documented in privacy.md, including your rights, and the legal basis. npm releases are published from this repository with signed provenance, so you can check the package against this source.

For developers

Editmamei is a stdio MCP server. In any MCP client, add a server that runs npx -y editmamei. The MCP reference covers client config, architecture, the MCP surface, settings and environment variables, and each network request the server makes.

The discovery chain is ps_ping (liveness), then ps_overview (the working method and capability map), then tools/list (the full schema-typed inventory). Every tool declares an outputSchema and returns typed JSON.

Build from source

git clone https://github.com/editmamei/editmamei.git
cd editmamei
npm install
npm run build
npm test

You need Node.js 22+ and Go 1.21+. The build compiles the editmamei-core binary that generates Photoshop scripts; it needs Go 1.27, which Go fetches for you from 1.21 on. The build warns instead of failing when Go is missing, so you can still run the test suite. Set EDITMAMEI_CORE_BIN to a prebuilt binary if you would rather not install Go.

The test suite runs without Photoshop. It verifies the ExtendScript Editmamei generates, never that Photoshop accepted it, so live verification against a real Photoshop is a separate step.

Contributions are welcome. CONTRIBUTING.md covers the CLA, the branch and pull-request flow, and what to include in a bug report.

Found a bug or want a feature? Use the issue tracker. If something's broken, ask your assistant to "report a problem" (or run editmamei report) to drop an anonymized diagnostic bundle in your Downloads folder, then attach it to the issue. For security issues, see SECURITY.md and don't file them publicly.

License

Editmamei CE is Fair Source software under the Functional Source License, v1.1, MIT Future License (FSL-1.1-MIT).

You can read, run, modify, and redistribute the code for almost anything: commercial photo editing, internal tools, education, research, security review. The one thing the license holds back, for two years per release, is offering the code to others in a commercial product or service that competes with Editmamei CE or Pro. If you redistribute the code, keep the license and copyright notices with it. Two years after each version ships, that version automatically becomes available under plain MIT.

This section is a plain-English summary. The LICENSE file is the license; where they differ, the LICENSE file controls. Editmamei is not open source under the OSI definition, and we don't call it that. It is source-available, with the full CE stack developed in the open.

Editmamei Pro is a separate, commercially licensed module; its source is not published. Third-party dependencies keep their own licenses, listed in NOTICES.md.
